function.description:
**TAG PHRASE EXCLUSION:**
- If the user asks for ports or interfaces `tagged`, `with <value> tag`, `under tag <value>`, or `in tag <value>`, do not treat `<value>` as an interface name, port name, device name, site name, or inventory filter.
- The value is a tag name. Use `api_getTag` followed by `api_getTagMembersById` for lists, or `api_getTagMemberCount` for counts.

**NOT FOR NAMED-TAG MEMBERSHIP:**
- Do not select this tool when the user starts from one named tag and asks which ports or interfaces belong to it.
- Do not select this tool for counts of ports or interfaces inside one named tag.
- This tool lists interfaces by interface/device attributes; it does not resolve a tag name to tag members.
- For tag-to-port or tag-to-interface membership, select `api_getTag` together with `api_getTagMembersById`.
- For tag-to-port or tag-to-interface counts, select `api_getTag` together with `api_getTagMemberCount`.

This API allows the user to get all Interfaces
function.name: api_getInterfaces

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be fetched. If not provided, 500 records will be fetched by default

offset.description: The first record to show for this page. Minimum value is 1
